systems.name: Atos Forge V2
systems.notes: Deterministic requirement validator (34 weasel words, 6-dimension enhancer), mandatory 100% coverage planner with 12-dimension plan-checker, 11-layer verification engine with hash lock and fix loop (repeated-error kill), Constitution.md + PreToolUse guard hook, session ledger with cross-milestone knowledge propagation, 17-agent catalog factory. Self-hosted CLI, MIT license. Loses on enterprise (no SSO/RBAC/compliance certifications, no SaaS offering) and extensibility (Claude-specific, no MCP server, no plugin ecosystem).

systems.name: Augment Code (Intent)
systems.notes: Living spec as core primitive, Coordinator-Implementor-Verifier (CIV) pattern with DAG, 6 parallel specialist agents, 400K+ file Context Engine, mandatory pre/post-execution human gates. SOC 2 Type II, ISO 42001, SSO/SCIM, CMEK. $252M funding, $977M valuation. No self-hosted option. Credit-based pricing.

systems.name: Tessl
systems.notes: 10-phase spec-driven workflow (constitution to export), anti-circular-verification via locked Gherkin tests, 2000+ runtime knowledge tiles, agent-agnostic (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode). $125M funding from Index/Accel, founded by Snyk creator. Enterprise features still developing (no SSO/RBAC/audit).

systems.name: Factory AI
systems.notes: 5 specialized Droids (Code, Review, Docs, Test, Knowledge) with coordinator. DroidShield pre-commit security/IP analysis. Review Droid role boundary (cannot patch own complaints). SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001. Cloud, hybrid, and fully airgapped deployment. NVIDIA, Adobe, Morgan Stanley customers. $150M Series C at $1.5B.

systems.name: GitHub Spec Kit
systems.notes: Best requirements framework: specify -> plan -> tasks -> implement with quality checklists. Agent-agnostic (30+ AI coding tools). 80K stars. No execution engine, no verification pipeline, no knowledge persistence. Specification toolkit only.

systems.name: Intent Integrity Kit (IIKit)
systems.notes: SHA256 cryptographic integrity chains prevent test tampering. 10-phase pipeline with git hook enforcement. Agent-agnostic. Compliance-oriented with audit trail. Small community (1.2K stars). No execution engine, no knowledge persistence.

systems.name: Superpowers
systems.notes: Composable markdown-based skills framework. Brainstorm -> plan -> implement with subagent-driven TDD. Two-stage review (spec compliance + code quality). Agent-agnostic (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex). 121K stars. No built-in verification engine, no formal context budget management, no DAG scheduling.

systems.name: MetaGPT
systems.notes: Multi-agent software company simulation (PM, Architect, Engineer, QA). SOP-driven pipeline generating PRD, design, tasks, code. ICLR 2025 oral (AFlow). 67K stars. Weak verification, limited human gates, no persistent knowledge, development slowed.

systems.name: OpenHands (formerly OpenDevin)
systems.notes: Most mature open-source AI developer platform (65K stars). Composable Python SDK for building coding agents. Docker sandbox isolation. 50%+ SWE-bench solve rate. Enterprise directory with RBAC/SSO. No structured spec-to-code pipeline, limited planning.

systems.name: Cognition Devin
systems.notes: Most autonomous AI developer with full isolated Linux sandbox. Compound AI (Planner + Coder + Critic). End-to-end testing via computer use. Enterprise VPC deployment. Playbook system. Microsoft, Dell, Cisco customers. $696M funding, $10.2B valuation. Limited human oversight, no formal spec workflow.

systems.name: ComposioHQ Agent Orchestrator
systems.notes: Agent-agnostic orchestrator (Claude Code, Codex, Aider). Git worktree isolation per agent. Autonomous CI failure fixing. 8 swappable architectural slots. Web dashboard. 3,288 test cases. No formal spec pipeline, no multi-layer verification, limited knowledge propagation.

systems.name: GitHub Copilot (Workspace / Coding Agent)
systems.notes: 100M+ developer distribution. Coding Agent (GA Sep 2025) works asynchronously in GitHub Actions. Agentic review -> coding agent pipeline. Workspace spec editing with downstream regeneration. SOC 1/2, FedRAMP, US/EU data residency, IP indemnity. No multi-agent orchestration, no formal verification engine.

systems.name: CodeRabbit
systems.notes: Best-in-class code review: LLM + 40 static analysis tools in ephemeral containers. Issue Planner (Feb 2026) bridges planning and review. Learns from team patterns. 4 Git platform support. SOC 2 Type II. 2M+ repos, 13M+ PRs, 8K+ customers. Review-focused, not a code generation or execution platform.

systems.name: Open SWE (LangChain)
systems.notes: True multi-agent architecture (Planner, Coder, Reviewer). Async cloud execution with human messaging mid-task. Multiple sandbox providers (Modal, Daytona, Runloop). Slack/Linear/GitHub integration. LangGraph ecosystem. No structured spec pipeline, no persistent knowledge.

systems.name: Replit Agent
systems.notes: Multi-agent (Manager, Editor, Verifier). Novel REPL-based self-testing with browser automation. 200+ minute autonomous sessions. 30+ connectors. CVE detection. $922M funding, $9B valuation, 50M+ users. Cloud-only, no self-hosted. Focused on greenfield app creation.
